ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious File Characteristics Due to Missing Fields
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Executables in the Downloads folder without FileVersion,Description,Product,Company likely created with py2exe

sequences.query: ((process_description = "\?" AND process_file_version = "\?") OR (process_description = "\?" AND process_product = "\?") OR (process_description = "\?" AND process_company = "\?")) AND process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Downloads\\\\.*")
